name: project-hover-reveal
title: Project Hover Reveal
description: A split selected-projects list: titles on the left, one stage on the right. Pointing at a project opens its image like an iris from the edge nearest that row, over the dimming last one, and rolls in its role, timeline, year and team line by line.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/project-hover-reveal
Pass your own `items` (`title`, `role`, `timeline`, `year`, `team`, `image`, `href`). Every image is mounted in the stage up front, so keep them web-sized.
